note: Commercial RV park in pines in the Spalding tract on Eagle Lake's southwest shore, with a store selling fuel and propane at the entrance on The Strand. The eight F-row sites at the front look east over the airstrip and meadow to the lake. --Claude
summary: Eagle Lake RV Park (private, GS Park): $50 Std RV site posted (passes the gate exactly; $45 at GS 10%); Google 4.5/135; 70 FHU RV sites on the park map (operator text says 65), 50A; season ends Oct 31, F1-F8 stay open later. Lakeview kept as a distant view (~600-700 m over open ground) from the front F-row. Pin at the store ~100 m from the loops, OK.
flags: PRICE GATE: 'Std RV Site: $50/Day, $300/Week, $1,050/Month, $3,780/Season' (operator page, read 2026-11-26) - exactly $50, so not over the line; Good Sam Park (directory gs: true) brings it to $45. Google 4.5 stars from 135 reviews. Passes.

LONG-STAY: weekly, monthly and a $3,780 season rate are posted, but the operator leads with the $50 nightly rate, the reservations page says 'limited availability for RVs' for getaways, and the park sells itself as a fishing base. No booking engine exists (form request only), so the one-night occupancy check could not be run. Not read as mostly seasonal.

WATERFRONT lakeview kept, distant: the operator calls the 2026 F1-F8 'large lake view RV spaces'. On imagery the lake's open water is ~600-700 m east of the front sites, across The Strand, the Spalding airstrip and an open marsh/meadow - open ground, so a view is plausible, but far. The loop sites 1-52/P1-P10 are under pine and have no view. Reviewer may prefer not waterfront given the distance.

SEASON: the stored opens 05-01 came from note prose; no operator page gives an opening day (none on home, accommodations, reservations, activities or events). Result writes closes 10-31 (was 12-01) and leaves opens as stored - consider clearing it.
